package.name: so101_owl_demo
package.description: Open-vocabulary object detection demo for the SO-101 on Qualcomm Hexagon NPU. The "swap the model, change what you look for" sibling of so101_depth_demo / so101_yolo_demo: same ONNX Runtime + QNN (HTP) inference pattern and the same camera input, but detects whatever free-form TEXT PROMPT you give it (default "a hand") using Qualcomm AI-Hub's OWL-ViT (OWL-ViT open-vocabulary detector, ViT-B/32 CLIP backbone) instead of a fixed COCO class set. Publishes an annotated visualisation, machine-readable vision_msgs/Detection2DArray detections, and the same /safety/protective_stop contract (ROI overlap + hysteresis) as its siblings, so the enforcement nodes (safety_pause_bridge / trajectory_safety_gate) never change. This is the Qualcomm/NPU counterpart of the Jetson-only NanoOWL variant.
